positioning: WYX is an opinionated multi-brand golf shop: the coolest products worth knowing about across apparel, footwear, golf tech, bags, trip gear and accessories. Curation is the product. Do not fill a department with weak inventory just to make it look complete.
principles: Legitimate retailer, wholesale, affiliate or fulfillment rights before listing a third-party product for sale.
No generic marketplace filler when a recognizable or genuinely distinctive specialist product can fill the same job.
Use actual product and lifestyle photography whenever possible; avoid generic fairway stock photography as the primary selling image.
Prefer a small number of hero products per department over dozens of interchangeable variants.
Do not publish unverified DSers products.
Every product should pass at least one test: looks excellent, solves a real golf problem, improves a trip, or sparks conversation.

doNotDo: Do not publish a category of generic AliExpress products to make the store look bigger.
Do not list premium brands without reseller authorization or an approved affiliate relationship.
Do not create fake product photos, specs, MSRP, inventory status or performance claims.
Do not let one supplier dominate the visual identity of WYX.
Do not call a belt-heavy assortment a complete apparel collection.
